root_cause.summary: ContractDrivenPerceptionService.compile() mixed compile with governed observation and relationship detection, making the perception payload boundary unobservable and capable of stalling without internal stage attribution.

A_eager_entity_materialization.evidence: Public trace spends ~18s in entity projection and projects 2230 entities before moving on.

B_cardinality_amplification.evidence: relationship_candidate_count=0 before terminal; no relationship explosion observed.

C_boundary_contamination.evidence: Original compile path executed relationship_detector.detect() and observation_boundary.execute(); patch introduced compile_only policy.

D_unbounded_payload_projection.evidence: Payload metrics and bounds added; public run did not reach payload assembly.

E_repeated_copying_serialization.evidence: No direct repeated JSON/deepcopy trace confirmed.

F_missing_payload_ref_boundary.evidence: Public compile did not reach payload assembly/bound check.

G_lock_synchronous_long_section.evidence: All endpoints and queue_runtime responded after terminal without restart.

H_complexity_pathology.evidence: Fact projection did not complete before artifact terminality budget after entity/relationship/observation stages completed.

I_observation_leakage.evidence: Observer execution was reachable inside compile before compile_only policy.

J_contract_over_request.evidence: No contract semantic reduction was applied or required for this wave.

patch_plan_applied: Added bounded internal compile stage trace to ContractPerceptionResult.
Added compile policy with compile_only mode for public artifact runtime.
Deferred observer execution and relationship detection inside compile_only.
Added bounded payload metrics and semantic payload/budget reasons.
Propagated generic stage-specific perception reasons through artifact runtime and store fallback.
Fixed checkpoint metadata so extra metadata cannot overwrite stage/bounded.
Prevented artifact_render_checkpoint emission after terminal event; late attempts become artifact_late_rejected only.
Added CVL perception payload compile frontier awareness.
